prompt:
Pixel art sprite sheet for a 2D vertical shoot-em-up arcade game. Exactly THREE separate enemy machines, stacked vertically in three rows, one enemy per row, each centered in its own row with clear empty gaps above and below it, nothing crossing the row boundaries. Direct top-down view of alien war machines, nose pointing to the BOTTOM of each row, engine nozzles at the TOP. Crisp readable pixel clusters, retro arcade pixel art, no anti-aliased blur, hard one-pixel rim highlight, worn gunmetal hull plates, panel lines, rivets, hazard stripe accents, one glowing energy core each. The whole background is a completely flat solid pure magenta colour rgb(255,0,255), no gradient, no shadows, no floor, no clouds, no stars. No text, no watermark.

ROW 1 (top): BOMBER. Fat heavy armoured munitions carrier, wide blunt hull, two enormous bomb-bay drums slung on either side with visible rounded shells inside, clustered release racks under the belly, mustard-yellow and dark gunmetal livery with black-and-yellow hazard stripes, small red targeting eye at the nose.

ROW 2 (middle): SPLITTER. Organic-mechanical crystalline pod, round segmented hull that looks like it breaks apart, jagged fracture seams glowing hot orange along the split lines, spiky shell plates, violet and bone-white carapace with teal circuit veins, single green core in the middle.

ROW 3 (bottom): RAMMER. Sleek dart-shaped suicide interceptor, narrow needle nose with a hardened tungsten tip, swept-back razor fins, tiny recessed cockpit, long thin engines at the top trailing short afterburners, chrome and black livery with crimson stripes and a warning skull marking on the spine.
